mnemonic.meaning: The day (日) attached (付) to the document. The date.
mnemonic.reading: HE ZOO-KAY (ひづけ): he writes the date on his zoo ticket. OK!

examples.ja: 書類に今日の日付を書いてください。
examples.en: Please write today's date on the form.

items.note: The date written or printed. 日にち is a date or a number of days.

mnemonic.meaning: 亡 is death: you lose someone because they die.
mnemonic.reading: KNOCK, SUE (なくす): Sue hears the knock with the news. She's lost her grandfather.

examples.ja: 彼は事故で父を亡くした。
examples.en: He lost his father in an accident.

items.note: For people. Losing things is 無くす.

mnemonic.meaning: The same (同) will (志). A comrade, a like-minded person.
mnemonic.reading: DOUGH, SHE (どうし): she shares her dough with her comrades.

examples.ja: 同志を集めて会を作った。
examples.en: He gathered like-minded people and formed a group.

items.note: 同志 = shared ideals. 同士 = people of the same kind.

mnemonic.meaning: 説 has 言 (words): words that explain and persuade.
mnemonic.reading: TOE-COO (とく): the preacher explains, persuading you with his toe.

examples.ja: 先生は勉強の大切さを説いた。
examples.en: The teacher explained the importance of study.

items.note: Formal. Often for teaching or persuading. 説明する is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 裂 has 衣 (clothes): the cloth tears by itself. To tear, to split.
mnemonic.reading: SAKE, RUE (さける): your sake bag splits open. You rue it.

examples.ja: 強い風で旗が裂けた。
examples.en: The flag tore in the strong wind.

items.note: Intransitive partner of 裂く (Level 11). 口が裂けても言えない = I'd never say it.

mnemonic.meaning: True (真) reason (理). The universal truth.
mnemonic.reading: SHIN, REE (しんり): he kicks your shin and says, "That's the truth."

examples.ja: 彼は真理を求めて旅に出た。
examples.en: He set out on a journey in search of truth.

items.note: Philosophical truth. 真実 (しんじつ) is the facts of a matter.

mnemonic.meaning: Connect (連) one idea (想) to another. Association of ideas.
mnemonic.reading: WREN SO (れんそう): a wren makes you think of spring. Association.

examples.ja: 青い色から海を連想する。
examples.en: The colour blue makes me think of the sea.

items.note: AからBを連想する = A reminds you of B.

mnemonic.meaning: Advance (進) step (歩) by step. Progress.
mnemonic.reading: SHIN, POH (しんぽ): progress, one shin at a time.

examples.ja: 科学技術は大きく進歩した。
examples.en: Science and technology have made great progress.

items.note: Improvement in skill or society. 進化 (しんか) = evolution.

mnemonic.meaning: Set up (設) the plan (計). A design, a layout.
mnemonic.reading: SECK-KAY (せっけい): "Say, OK!" The architect approves the design.

examples.ja: この家は有名な建築家が設計した。
examples.en: A famous architect designed this house.

items.note: Design in engineering and architecture. 人生設計 = life plan. デザイン is looks and style.

mnemonic.meaning: Use (用) your heart (心), keep your mind on it. Caution, care.
mnemonic.reading: YO, GIN (ようじん): "Yo, careful with the gin!"

examples.ja: 火の用心。
examples.en: Beware of fire.

items.note: 用心深い = cautious. 火の用心 is a traditional fire-safety call.

mnemonic.meaning: SHIBA, SHIBA (しばしば): the shiba dog often, frequently comes back to visit.

examples.ja: 彼はしばしば会議に遅れる。
examples.en: He's often late for meetings.

items.note: Formal and written. よく / たびたび are close.

mnemonic.meaning: Start (発) and reach (達) further. Development, growth.
mnemonic.reading: HAT, TATS (はったつ): his hat collection develops into tattoos too.

examples.ja: 子供の言葉の発達は早い。
examples.en: Children's language develops quickly.

items.note: Natural growth: 体の発達, 技術の発達. 発展 is growth of cities and economies.

mnemonic.meaning: Divide (分) the field (野). A field of study, an area.
mnemonic.reading: BUN, YA (ぶんや): baking buns is your field, yeah.

examples.ja: 彼は医学の分野で有名だ。
examples.en: He's famous in the field of medicine.

items.note: Field of study or work. 専門分野 = your speciality.

mnemonic.meaning: The head (首) city (都). The capital.
mnemonic.reading: SHOE TOE (しゅと): the capital city is where the best shoes are.

examples.ja: 日本の首都は東京だ。
examples.en: The capital of Japan is Tokyo.

items.note: 首都圏 = the greater Tokyo area.

mnemonic.meaning: A group (団) as one body (体). An organization.
mnemonic.reading: DAN TIE (だんたい): Dan wears a tie for his organization.

examples.ja: 団体で旅行すると安くなる。
examples.en: It's cheaper if you travel as a group.

items.note: 団体旅行 = group tour. 団体戦 = team match.

mnemonic.meaning: Go out (出) to the place (場) where the game is. Take part in a competition.
mnemonic.reading: SHOE, TSU, JOE (しゅつじょう): Joe ties his shoes and takes part in the race.

examples.ja: 彼はオリンピックに出場した。
examples.en: He competed in the Olympics.

items.note: Competing in an event or tournament. 出席 (しゅっせき) is attending a class or meeting.

mnemonic.meaning: 務 is duty, service: your role.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, TOE, MEh (つとめ): your duty is to clean your toe, meh.

examples.ja: 子供を守るのは親の務めだ。
examples.en: It's a parent's duty to protect their children.

items.note: Duty. 勤め (same reading) = employment, a job.

mnemonic.meaning: Become (成) a person (人), a full one. An adult.
mnemonic.reading: SAY GIN (せいじん): "Say, I'm an adult now, I can drink gin."

examples.ja: 日本では十八歳で成人になる。
examples.en: In Japan you become an adult at 18.

items.note: 成人式 = coming-of-age ceremony. 大人 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Mix (交) on the occasion (際). Dating, a relationship.
mnemonic.reading: COKE, SIGH (こうさい): they share a Coke and sigh. They're dating.

examples.ja: 二人は一年前から交際している。
examples.en: The two have been seeing each other for a year.

items.note: Formal. 付き合う (WaniKani) is everyday. Also social relations: 交際費 (entertainment expenses).

mnemonic.meaning: Two picture kanji (絵, 画): a painting.
mnemonic.reading: KITE-GA (かいが): a painting of a kite.

examples.ja: 美術館で有名な絵画を見た。
examples.en: I saw famous paintings at the art museum.

items.note: Formal, art-world word. 絵 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 包 is wrap: something wrapped up. A package.
mnemonic.reading: TSU TSU, ME (つつみ): you wrap the package for me.

examples.ja: 母から大きな包みが届いた。
examples.en: A big parcel arrived from my mother.

items.note: 包み紙 = wrapping paper.

items.pos: noun, する verb, な adjective

mnemonic.meaning: EAT A ZOO RAH (いたずら)! The kids prank the zoo. Mischief!

examples.ja: 子供のいたずらで窓が割れた。
examples.en: The window got broken by a child's mischief.

items.note: Kanji: 悪戯. いたずら電話 = prank call.

mnemonic.meaning: One (一) person (人), one (一) person (人): each person, one by one.
mnemonic.reading: HE TORI, HE TORI (ひとりひとり): one bird, then another bird... one by one.

examples.ja: 先生は生徒一人一人に声をかけた。
examples.en: The teacher spoke to each student.

items.note: Emphasises each individual.

mnemonic.meaning: 覚 is wake up: you come to your senses.
mnemonic.reading: SAME, RUE (さめる): the same alarm wakes you up, and you rue it. Same sound as 冷める (cool down).

examples.ja: 朝早く目が覚めた。
examples.en: I woke up early in the morning.

items.note: 目が覚める = to wake up. Transitive: 覚ます.

mnemonic.meaning: 深 is deep: it grows deeper by itself.
mnemonic.reading: FOO, CAR, MARU (ふかまる): the car drives in circles, deepening the mud.

examples.ja: 秋が深まってきた。
examples.en: Autumn has deepened.

items.note: Intransitive partner of 深める (Level 11).

mnemonic.meaning: A mind (意) full of respect (敬). Regard.
mnemonic.reading: KAY, EE (けいい): Kay shows great respect for her elders.

examples.ja: 先輩に敬意を払う。
examples.en: I show respect to my seniors.

items.note: 敬意を払う / 表す = to pay respect. 敬語 = honorific language.

mnemonic.meaning: 善 has 羊 (sheep) on top: the gentle sheep is good. Goodness, virtue.
mnemonic.reading: ZEN (ぜん): a Zen monk is the picture of goodness.

examples.ja: 善と悪の区別。
examples.en: Telling good from evil.

items.note: Formal. 善は急げ = do good things quickly (strike while the iron is hot).

mnemonic.meaning: Perform (演) an explanation (説). A speech.
mnemonic.reading: EN, ZETS (えんぜつ): the speaker ends with "That's it!"

examples.ja: 首相が国民に向けて演説した。
examples.en: The prime minister gave a speech to the nation.

items.note: A public speech, often political. スピーチ is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Go (行) ahead (先). Preceding, leading.
mnemonic.reading: SEN, COKE (せんこう): the sensei goes ahead with the Coke.

examples.ja: チケットの先行販売が始まった。
examples.en: The advance ticket sale has started.

items.note: 先行き = the outlook ahead.

mnemonic.meaning: The time (頃) near (近) now. Recently, these days.
mnemonic.reading: CHICAGO, ROW (ちかごろ): these days, everyone in Chicago rows.

examples.ja: 近頃、物価が高くなった。
examples.en: Prices have gone up recently.

items.note: Slightly old-fashioned. 最近 is everyday.
